name: Annual Title I Parent and Family Meeting
description: Annual meeting explaining Title I goals and purposes and parents' right to be involved, with information on programs, curriculum, assessments and achievement levels.
preparedBy: Each District school operating a Title I program
quote: Each District school operating a Title I program shall hold an annual meeting of parents and family members at a convenient time, to explain the goals and purposes of Title I programs and to inform them of their right to be involved.
